normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real native skeletal palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default; turn begins facing left, passes two native rear-three-quarter bodies and ends facing right.
visualValidation.outfit: Tall skeletal knight: single left eye (screen-right in front view), no lower jaw, worn silver armour, dark navy cape; no helmet, red plume, horned shoulder or flesh.
visualValidation.weapons: Physical short sword in right hand, sheathed during locomotion/jumps/ledge contacts. No shield in the selected loadout: shield-labelled states depict actual short-sword parry.
visualValidation.stature: 200px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Generated source-version gameplay adaptation, not official original game frames or certified 1:1.
Opposite facing is a runtime horizontal mirror; anatomical handedness is not certified in the mirrored camp.
Shared airborne, guard/parry, charge and physical ledge mechanics are original bounded platform-fighter adaptations.
